note: Tarot archetypes are narrative labels for decision situations, not personality diagnoses.

cards.name: The Fool
cards.general_meaning: New beginnings, experimentation, and stepping into uncertainty.
cards.core_question: Will I step into the unknown?

cards.name: The Magician
cards.general_meaning: Agency, resourcefulness, and creating something with what is available.
cards.core_question: Can I make something happen with what I have?

score_axis.label: Initiative with available resources
score_axis.score_1: Waits for clearer support or sufficient resources
score_axis.score_3: Acts quickly and improvises with what is available

cards.name: The Lovers
cards.general_meaning: Connection, alignment, and the values or relationships that shape a choice.
cards.core_question: Who or what matters most in this choice?

score_axis.label: Weight given to connection and shared values
score_axis.score_1: Prioritizes an independent or immediate practical path
score_axis.score_2: Looks for balance among competing commitments
score_axis.score_3: Prioritizes connection or deeply held shared values

cards.name: The Chariot
cards.general_meaning: Drive, momentum, and how intensely someone pursues a goal.
cards.core_question: How hard will I push toward the goal?

score_axis.label: Intensity of goal pursuit
score_axis.score_1: Protects stability and a sustainable pace
score_axis.score_2: Pushes forward while managing risk and capacity
score_axis.score_3: Pursues the goal aggressively despite uncertainty

cards.name: Strength
cards.general_meaning: Courage, restraint, and responding constructively when pressure rises.
cards.core_question: How do I respond when emotion or pressure rises?

score_axis.label: Response intensity under pressure
score_axis.score_1: Creates distance or waits before engaging
score_axis.score_2: Responds with measured regulation and clarity
score_axis.score_3: Acts directly and immediately under pressure

cards.name: The Hermit
cards.general_meaning: Reflection, independence, and making room for one's own judgment.
cards.core_question: Do I need space to think before I act?

score_axis.label: Need for independent reflection
score_axis.score_1: Acts with the group or available guidance
score_axis.score_2: Balances outside input with personal reflection
score_axis.score_3: Seeks substantial private reflection before acting

cards.name: Death
cards.general_meaning: Transformation, endings, and deciding when to release an old direction.
cards.core_question: When is it time to end the old and change direction?

score_axis.label: Readiness to let go and transform
score_axis.score_1: Preserves continuity and the familiar structure
score_axis.score_2: Keeps what works while changing selected parts
score_axis.score_3: Lets go decisively and begins a new direction

cards.name: The Star
cards.general_meaning: Hope, renewal, and investing in a possibility whose value may take time to appear.
cards.core_question: Will I invest in a hopeful possibility?

score_axis.label: Investment in uncertain possibility
score_axis.score_1: Prefers reliable and immediately visible value
score_axis.score_2: Tests hopeful possibilities through a practical pilot
score_axis.score_3: Invests in ambitious long-term possibility despite uncertainty
